facts: No snow or storms in the forecast this week; highs near 63°F at pass elevation.

avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 10 to 22 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: left May 7; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 24 (2024), May 22 (2025)

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: left May 26; earlier seasons: June 23 (2023), June 17 (2024), June 2 (2025)

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: left May 5; earlier seasons: May 29 (2023), May 15 (2024), May 10 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the third highest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Alpine Meadows (3,500 ft) and Skookum Creek (3,320 ft) and the lowest at Stevens Pass (3,940 ft).

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: 23.6 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 40.0 in (2023), 30.2 in (2024), 32.5 in (2025)

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: 36.2 in on April 19; earlier seasons: 61.3 in (2023), 38.0 in (2024), 35.1 in (2025)

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: 23.0 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 53.3 in (2023), 22.9 in (2024), 26.2 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between March 26 and May 19, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Stevens Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 7, 1,345 ft above the pass; points to March 13 to May 15

evidence.name: Alpine Meadows
evidence.detail: melted out May 26, 905 ft above the pass; points to April 12 to June 7

evidence.name: Skookum Creek
evidence.detail: melted out May 5, 725 ft above the pass; points to March 26 to May 19
